parsed.doc_summary: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulations Chapter 14 (security deposits): interest-bearing account requirement and deposit ceiling (one month's max allowable rent; two months for small natural-person landlords, amended eff. 8/17/24), with limited additional deposit for pre-1999 tenancies.

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulation 14002: Ceiling on Security Deposit
rules.requirement: For controlled rental units, the security deposit generally cannot exceed the maximum allowable rent or base rent after vacancy on the initial rental date. Small landlords (natural person or all-natural-person LLC, owning no more than two properties with four or fewer units total) may demand two months' rent from non-service-member tenants. Once set, the deposit cannot be raised during the tenancy.
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulations ch. 14
rules.quoted_span: The landlord may demand a security deposit in an amount equal to two months’ rent if the prospective tenant is not a service member and both the following are true:
rules.key_value: 1 month's max allowable rent; 2 months for qualifying small landlords
rules.effective_date_note: Two-month small-landlord provision amended 8/8/24, effective 8/17/24; the original ceiling dates from 1983 (effective 12/7/83).
rules.exemptions: Applies to controlled rental units only.
rules.coverage_conditions: Controlled rental units under Santa Monica rent control.

unverifiable_exemptions: units not under Santa Monica rent control
coverage.landlord_size_condition: Two-month deposit only for a natural person or all-natural-person LLC owning no more than two residential rental properties with no more than four dwelling units total

rules.interaction: Total deposit cannot exceed the state maximum (see § 14003(c)).

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulation 14001: Interest-Bearing Account
rules.requirement: Landlords must hold all security deposits in an interest-bearing account at an FDIC- or FSLIC-insured institution until the deposit is returned to the tenant or the landlord is entitled to use it.
rules.quoted_span: All security deposits shall be placed in an interest-bearing account at an institution whose accounts are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or the Federal Savings and Loan Insurance Corporation
rules.key_value: Deposits must be held in an insured interest-bearing account
rules.conflict_note: Subsections (b)-(f) of 14001 were suspended 6/13/02; only subsection (a) is reproduced here.
